fusions.name: Fae-Bane Cut
fusions.desc: A cut that deals 30 damage, ignores resistances, and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Unbending Ring
fusions.desc: Sweeps the blade around you, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, stripping 12% of their armour for 4 seconds and slowing them by 10%. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Forged Guard
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 6 seconds, and raises your armour by 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Quenched Temper
fusions.desc: When you are hurt, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
